The sun never shines in Rook City.  It seems like it's always been that way.  But sometimes, if you are lucky, the clouds part and the Moon shines through.

This was one of those moments.  Everything went right, for a brief shining moment the heroes luck turned, and an opening presented itself.

"Where'd he go?"  Nightmist asked.

Nobody had an answer.
